text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I peer into the dance studio and see
Seeking the
Pearl together with El
Condor Pasa, practicing
dance moves.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: One, two, one, two! Now turn!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué haces?! Are you sure that's the next
move?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't fuss over the details, El! Come on,
put some
passion into that turn!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: O-okay! Turn!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let your feelings guide your step!
Picture in your
mind our blazing passion
taking flight and soaring
through the
skies!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay, El! Now imagine the two of us in

magnificent outfits, standing before
endless fields
of green that stretch out
beneath the infinite sky!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Our passion will reach all the way to that
distant
horizon!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A-all right! I'll dance with blazing
passion!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's the spirit! Just concentrate on

expressing the emotions bursting forth
from
within!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We can soar as high and far as we desire!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm goin' all out and soarin' into
the sky!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad they're both having fun, but it
seems
they've strayed quite a bit from
the actual
routine.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Bravo, El! Thank you for that
impassioned dance!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. That may be so, but a live
performance is
all about sharing your
passion with fans!
choice_data_list: Still, this is pretty far off from the original choreography...
Still, we're straying pretty far from the original choreography...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing more important than
expressing
the emotion that pours from
your heart!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Let's keep this up and polish our

expressive abilities!
choice_data_list: The thrill of a synchronized dance is its own kind of passion.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Roger that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but... won't everyone else on stage
get mad if
we're not doing the same
moves as them?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I suppose it would be uncouth to
disrupt the
harmony of the performance.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well then, how about busting out some
freestyle
moves during the interlude?
People sometimes do
their own thing
then, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We can use that time to express
ourselves to our
hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué bien! That's a great idea! I'll follow
your lead
to the ends of the earth!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them create a dance
routine
overflowing with passion.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That makes sense. Somebody
must have
put a lot of effort into
choreographing this group
performance.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it's our job to take that
enthusiasm
and refine it to an even purer
form!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that was some spot-on advice,
Trainer!
Let's get back to practicing the
original
choreography!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Er, what was the next move after that
last step
again?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pearl, don't tell me you were doing a
different
dance 'cause you forgot the
steps!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha! There's no need to dig up trivial
matters
like that, El!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following that, Seeking the Pearl learns
the
correct choreography from El
Condor Pasa, and
they master the dance
moves for the
performance.
